parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The object tags that match the lifecycle rule. You can specify multiple tags.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-api-group --group-id 523e8dc7bbe04613b5b1d726c2a7889d --tag Value=test_app Key=appname --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DescribeApiGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key appname --Tag.1.Value test_app --GroupId 523e8dc7bbe04613b5b1d726c2a7889d
